notes.description: Question about 1:15 slope tier (max run 10.50m, max rise 700mm, landing interval every 10.00m). Answer B is correct. Rationale properly distinguishes 10.00m (interval trigger) from 10.50m (absolute maximum run).
Question about GOLD-MAX-RENO slope tiers. Answer B is correct: GOLD=1:20, MAX=1:15, RENO=1:12.
Question about dual handrail heights (700/900mm) and rise threshold (>170mm). Answer C is correct.
Question about edge protection curb height (100mm). Answer C is correct with proper rationale.
Question about 1:12 compliance in new construction. Answer B correctly identifies 1:12 as renovation-only exception.
Question about ramp footprint computation (26.4m total). Answer B is correct with proper landing count.
Question about error identification (1500mm landing vs 1800mm; 1:12 vs 1:15). Answer B correctly identifies both errors.
Question about GOLD (15.00m) and MAX (10.00m) landing intervals. Answer B correctly distinguishes interval from max run.
Question about min clear width (1200mm) vs PD 1096 corridor requirement (≥1100mm). Answer C is correct.
Question about BP 344 dual handrail heights (700/900mm) vs PD 1096 stair handrail (800-900mm). Answer B correctly distinguishes regimes.
